claim_policy: Completed implementation and completed experiments are distinct from satisfied scientific performance requirements. Negative and unavailable outcomes are not relabeled as successful closure.

stages.requirement: Unambiguous C/P/F/f/H/K, conditioning, times, firing, reset and refractory contract
limits: Model probability is not established as a content-label posterior.
Threshold/reset dynamics do not themselves certify a bifurcation or phase transition.

stages.requirement: Low-dimensional Bellman/QVI including post-firing value, independently verified solutions and gradients
limits: Current content network retains a Brownian/Erlang boundary and finite fixed-policy value surrogate.
A feasible improvement of at least about 4.6051 percent over the legacy boundary remains preserved.
Ordinary two-threshold policy ties the exact task oracle on 20 registered task/grid cases.

stages.requirement: Joint learning of content, dynamics, boundary, reset and refractory components with interpretable freezes
limits: Freezing the named boundary group freezes raw_K; dynamics can still move the boundary.
Gradient flow alone does not establish positive task benefit.

stages.requirement: Isolate value-boundary and dual-channel benefit under matched information, active parameters and complete cost
limits: Four Holm mechanism families are distinct; no unified global family control is claimed.
Equal optimizer-training CPU is not equal whole-worker or whole-system cost.

observed.external_pass_scope: MQAR ID/OOD versus LIF using ordinary features; no J/G dual-channel attribution

stages.requirement: Stable content capability on selective copy, MQAR, temporal extrapolation and real multimodal encoding
limits: One offline audiovisual domain and 8 heldout actors; no foundation-model capability claim.
No exhaustive tuning or broad modern strong-baseline coverage.

stages.requirement: Actual Hepta messages/state/reset/stop plus tuned hardware, full costs, latency, energy and scale
limits: Python/PyTorch computes the neural kernel; native owner enforces real messages and KEEP/STOP.
Engineering stopping is not demonstrated classification-optimal stopping.
484 bytes excludes weights, inputs, outputs, temporaries, logs and BPTT graphs.
Current CPU reference is slower; unavailable CUDA is not evidence that no GPU exists.
